purpose: Optional unsent selector for existing Boston transfer/pledge application packets, after baseline register availability and scope are established. Not a request submission, paid-copy order, claim of completion or current debt status.
missing_license_id_note: Four rows describe two combined transfer/pledge items whose printed source omits the license ID. They remain selectable by source date, item and parties.
page_link_note: Source URLs identify voting documents, not application attachments. PDF #page fragments are navigation hints; three HTML-document events have no page number. Item numbers are separate exact fields.
repeat_policy: No deduplication: repeated decisions, combined transfer/pledge rows, releases and revocation notices are preserved. An office may supply a single shared packet for rows from the same application.
outcome_scope: Outcome is the source-document action, not a representation of closing, ownership consummation or present lien status.
